items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Henderson Tapps' in the context of a timeline ('34 with Henderson Tapps'), but the interviewee (Joe Thomas) does not respond to this specific mention or provide any personal anecdote, confirmation of meeting, or description of a relationship.

ctx.x: He's a great drummer. Tremendous drummer. We had a situation in '34. Oh, Stan, let me tell you about this.
Yeah, well, that's what he's got, '34 with Henderson Tapps' for a few months and then with Ferman Pat band at Small____.
Ferman Tapps, yes. Well, a fellow by the name of Joe Jordan, he passed about a couple years ago. He was about 80 or 90 years old.
